thread:
alicia: heads-up — switching our sample app from REST -> python sdk and create_deployment blows up with an unexpected kwarg error. REST accepts a `region` header but `client.create_deployment(model=\"rw-1\", region=\"eu-west-1\")` raises `TypeError: got unexpected keyword argument 'region'`. anyone seen this?

mike: which sdk version? can you paste the minimal repro (curl vs python) so we can triage quickly?

alicia: sdk==0.12.3. repro: curl:
`curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Region: eu-west-1\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments -d '{"model":"rw-1"}'` -> 200
python:
`client.create_deployment(model=\"rw-1\", region=\"eu-west-1\")` -> TypeError above.

sandra: mm. this smells like our param-mapping wrapper that strips unknown kwargs to keep signatures stable. we intentionally hid unknown kwargs in older sdks, but we regressed and started dropping valid service-level params like region.

mike: also seeing a related auth/retry quirk on node: if the sdk drops the region header, the service returns a 401 and our client auto-retries the whole request during token refresh which causes repeated calls. logs show: `auth: refresh token failed, retrying` then another create_deployment attempt. looks like retry policy treats 401 as transient.

andy: pushing a PR to fix both: stop filtering unknown kwargs for endpoint-level passthrough, and tighten retry logic to not auto-retry on 401/403 (only retry on 429/5xx/timeouts). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 (WIP). I'll add unit tests that compare `client.create_deployment` signature vs service contract.

alicia: thanks — can we also backport to 0.12.x? sample app pinned to 0.12.3 in onboarding. need a hotfix so new users don't hit this during quickstart. i'll open sample app PR to bump once patch lands.

devops-bot: CI report: wheel build failed for py3.11 on linux in job tests/test_create_deployment.py::test_region_passthrough (see logs).

sandra: ok i'll cherry-pick the fix and run a patch release candidate. want to keep the changelog entry small: `fix(sdk): passthrough service params (region) and avoid retrying on auth failures`. can someone approve the cherry-pick?

mike: +1 :thumbsup:

alicia: super, thanks. i'll update the sample app README and add a note under onboarding troubleshooting.

andy: will post the release branch and ping release-war-room when it's ready.

alicia: appreciate it — this was a painful onboarding hiccup for a new trial customer earlier today.
